plain_english: In middle-center expansion — but the means: powerful state, thought-decay-tightening-opening and the rest, in many ways.
sanskrit_cite: madhyadhāmavikāse tu upāyo balavatsthitiḥ | vikalpakṣayasaṅkocavikāsādyā anekaśaḥ

plain_english: From thinking-of-nothing indeed, thoughts' decay may be. From knowing-awareness, playful power, attached-therein, in being's realm.
sanskrit_cite: akiñciccintanād eva vikalpānāṃ kṣayo bhavet | cidbodhād vilasacchaktī raktāsau bhāvamaṇḍale

plain_english: There-attached, the divine stream sees the pure-natured; power-tightening — this indeed, it is said by brahma-teachers.
sanskrit_cite: tatrānuraktā divyaughaṃ paśyate vimalātmakam | śaktisaṅkocam etad dhi procyate brahmavādibhiḥ

plain_english: Thus this said: goddess, middle-center-expansion — there capable, in days thus obtains supreme prosperity.
sanskrit_cite: ity etat kathitaṃ devi madhyadhāmavikāsakam | tatra śakto dinair evaṃ prapnoti parasampadam

plain_english: Who inner-samādhi-impressed wanders, of pure radiance — by emission-power indeed reflecting, and again, again.
sanskrit_cite: yo 'ntaḥsamādhisaṃskāraṃ bhramate vimalatviṣām | sa visargabalād eva vimṛśya ca punaḥ punaḥ

plain_english: In distraction even — for his own form fully manifests — of the yogi fixed in awareness, of eternal-bliss-essence.
sanskrit_cite: vyutthāne 'pi yatas tasya svarūpaṃ samprakāśate | yogino bodhaniṣṭhasya nityānandarasasya ca

plain_english: That full-of-manifest-bliss, mantra-power-strengthened, full-I-ness knowing — thus of inner-exultation-practitioner.
sanskrit_cite: tat prakāśānandamayī mantravīryopabṛṃhitā | pūṛnāhantācid ity antaḥsamullāsābhiyoginaḥ

plain_english: There-that sporting yogi, in mantra-lord-status situated — there capable lord, as plays power-expanded.
sanskrit_cite: tatrāsau vilasan yogī mantreśvarapade sthitaḥ | tatra śakto vibhur yadvat krīḍate śaktibṛṃhitaḥ

plain_english: Thus freedom — his, all-pervading, world-Lord's, various-difference-enjoying — unbroken in wondrous state.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ svatantratā tasya vyāpakasya jagadvibhoḥ | nānābhedajuṣaś citrapadasthitasyākhaṇḍitā
